subject: strandbeest
pitch:
Category: Abstract.
Subject: wind-walking beach creature of tubes.
Style: Theo Jansen kinetic sculpture.

requests.what: Add three broad wind-direction chevrons and a small spiral emblem to the plain cream sail panel. Use BEACH_ORANGE, DEEP_TEAL, and DARK_INK, with crisp flat geometry that follows the sail surface.
Add a narrow triangular beach pennant at the mast crown, striped alternately in BEACH_ORANGE and SUN_YELLOW, with a short dark cap and a tiny dangling wind ribbon.
Add a small rotating wind vane on the front bulkhead: a horizontal axle, two opposing paddle blades, and a little orange central hub.
At every visible crank wheel, add a dark teal outer cap, a cream washer, and a small orange offset crank pin. Keep the linkage joints readable and leave the wheel faces mostly clear.
Add broad, low-profile sand paddles beneath each of the six feet. They should be rounded rectangular plates in BEACH_ORANGE with dark teal heel bands and two small cream studs per paddle.
Repeat the signature layered joint washers on every knee and ankle: two thin dark discs, one pale outer ring, and a small orange centre pin. Match the same detail on both sides.
Add two taut dark cables along each side rail, one high and one low, with small cream anchor collars at the front and rear hoops. The cables should visually tie the long body together.
Place a sparse row of small orange rivet heads along the sail's upper and lower tube edges, following the triangular outline without cluttering the central sail.
Add a small cream identification plate on the forward upper side of the body, framed in dark teal and marked with a simple three-line orange symbol.

Paint the long body tube with a restrained beach-weathered pattern: warm ivory as the base, pale sand on upward-facing facets, muted blue-grey on the underside, and occasional broad teal maintenance bands near the three crank stations.
Paint the sail as sun-bleached canvas: cream and muted straw panels with a few flat BEACH_ORANGE seam strips, keeping the centre visually open for the wind marks.

Use the same restrained material language on the articulated legs: pale polymer primary tubes, blue-grey shadow links, orange crank accents, and darker underside sections. Preserve the hard faceted Theo Jansen look.
